caption: The drawing features a stylized bust of a person depicted in profile facing right, located centrally on a plain, beige background. The head has an exaggerated, enlarged, rounded shape extending backward, colored solid black to represent the hair, which covers part of the left side of the head and comes to a point at the back. The face is outlined with fine black lines and includes minimal details: a single arched eyebrow, a simple eye with a straight upper lid and curved lower lid, a small nose, and lips drawn with two curved lines. The neck is elongated and slender, leading down to a simplified trapezoidal torso. A single thick black horizontal band encircles the upper torso, while the rest of the body is left uncolored, matching the beige background. There are no additional elements, patterns, or shading in the drawing.
title: Hat Mannequin
